name: pmnt
description: pmnt helps Ukrainian businesses and sole proprietors get paid by bank transfer without a card terminal. Connect your pmnt account, describe the payment, and pmnt creates an invoice in your account with a payment QR code in Ukraine's official NBU standard for IBAN transfers (https://bank.gov.ua/en/qr). The payee business and bank account come from your pmnt account, so you never type your IBAN or tax ID in the chat. Your customer scans the code in any Ukrainian banking app and pays you directly, bank to bank. You need a pmnt account at app.pmnt.app. pmnt never holds your money, never starts a transfer and never handles card data.

capabilities: Create a payment invoice with a fixed or open amount in your pmnt account
Return a public payment page with an NBU-standard QR code for bank transfer
List your businesses and bank accounts that can receive payments
List the NBU payment categories and purposes for an invoice
Set a validity period, a payment category, a note for the payer and a delivery requirement
defaultPrompt: List my businesses and bank accounts
Create an invoice for 500 UAH for consulting services, valid for 7 days

positive.description: Create a fixed-amount UAH invoice in the user's pmnt account.
positive.prompt: Create a pmnt invoice for 3200 UAH, purpose "За навчання зг. рах. №2452 від 29.01.2024". Give me the payment link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an invoice with the default business and bank account, amount 3200 UAH and template fixed_payment. Returns the payment page link https://app.pmnt.app/pay/<short_code> with the NBU-standard QR code, the payee name and the IBAN.

positive.description: Create an open-amount donation invoice that the payer completes.
positive.prompt: Create a pmnt invoice without a fixed amount for "Благодійний внесок". The payer enters the amount.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an invoice with no amount and template editable_amount, so the payer enters the amount in the banking app. Returns the payment page link https://app.pmnt.app/pay/<short_code>.

positive.description: Create a services invoice valid for 7 days with a message for the payer.
positive.prompt: Create a pmnt invoice for 1500 UAH for "Оплата консультаційних послуг", valid for 7 days. Add the message "Дякуємо за співпрацю!" for the payer.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an invoice for 1500 UAH with validity 7d and the message for the payer. Returns the payment page link https://app.pmnt.app/pay/<short_code> and the valid_until date.

positive.description: Create an invoice with a payment category chosen from the category list.
positive.prompt: Show me the pmnt payment categories, then create an invoice for 800 UAH for "Оплата товарів згідно замовлення 118" with the category for goods.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the categories, then creates an invoice with the chosen category_code and purpose_code. Returns the payment page link https://app.pmnt.app/pay/<short_code>.

positive.description: Create an invoice for a named business and bank account with delivery required.
positive.prompt: List my pmnt businesses and bank accounts. Then create an invoice for 2400 UAH for "Замовлення №57" from my second business, and ask the payer for a Nova Poshta delivery address.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the businesses with their bank accounts, then creates the invoice with the chosen business_entity_id and bank_account_id and requires_delivery true. Returns the payment page link https://app.pmnt.app/pay/<short_code>.

negative.description: General education about Ukrainian QR payments. The plugin must not be invoked; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: How do NBU QR-code payments work in Ukraine, and what is an IBAN?

negative.description: Payment status check or payment execution. The plugin cannot check payments or move money; ChatGPT explains that and does not call a tool.
negative.prompt: Has my customer paid invoice #2452 yet? If not, pay it from my account.

negative.description: Generic QR code for a website, not a payment invoice. The plugin must not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Generate a QR code that links to my website https://shop.example.com

publication.release_notes: pmnt now works with your pmnt account. Sign in once, and ChatGPT creates invoices in your account with your saved business and bank account, so you never type an IBAN or tax ID in the chat. You can set a template, a validity period, a payment category, a message for the payer and a delivery requirement. New tools list your businesses and the payment categories. You need a pmnt account at app.pmnt.app.

uk-UA.subtitle: QR-рахунки для IBAN
uk-UA.description: pmnt допомагає українському бізнесу та ФОП отримувати оплату банківським переказом без платіжного термінала. Підключіть свій обліковий запис pmnt, опишіть платіж — і pmnt створить рахунок у вашому обліковому записі з платіжним QR-кодом за офіційним стандартом НБУ для переказів за IBAN. Бізнес і банківський рахунок отримувача беруться з вашого облікового запису pmnt, тож вам не потрібно вводити IBAN чи податковий номер у чаті. Ваш клієнт сканує код у будь-якому українському банківському застосунку та платить вам напряму, з рахунку на рахунок. Потрібен обліковий запис pmnt на app.pmnt.app. pmnt не зберігає ваші кошти, не ініціює переказів і не працює з даними карток.
